name: Figma / master brytere og felt
principles: Builder/AI can edit presentation, order, layout choices and safe fields for one page at a time.
Collectium/MariaDB owns data, access, feature switches, routes, publish approval and live version.
Each page needs page_key, components, switches, APIs, data sources and DB status.
Switches can be boolean, text, select, number, JSON or safe_action.
